1. One story is that during a game against Georgia Tech, the Georgia Tech coach stated, "Your football team isn't worth a nickel, but you have a million dollar band."
2. In a second story, after a 1922 game against Georgia Tech that Alabama lost 33-7, an Atlanta sportswriter asked W. C. "Champ" Pickens, "You don't have much of a team; what do you have at Alabama?" Pickens replied, "A Million Dollar Band."
